answer: Slash on divergence. Draw five jurors for each submission, hold every payout in escrow until the fifth signature finalizes, and release a juror's bond only when its grade lands within one point of the panel median. Stuffing that panel with owned identities means posting a ferrous stake per seat and forfeiting it every time the planted grade drifts off the median. Price it from the delta: one honest attestation earns a walnut, one captured panel burns five stakes, so the attack costs five times the ember of approval it buys.
